FICTIONAL RETAILOPS DEMONSTRATION POLICY
Shelf counts: Store staff count shelves every Monday before opening and record discrepancies for manager review.
Replenishment: Review available stock, reserved stock, open purchase orders and recent completed-day demand. Maintain safety stock and respect the supplier minimum order quantity, pack size, cost and lead time.
Purchase approval: A manager must explicitly review the proposal and record a reason before approval. Approval does not receive stock; receiving is a separate audited action. No supplier order is sent by the assistant.
Sales interpretation: Stockouts may be associated with lower sales, but they do not prove that stockouts caused a sales decline.
